description: Native-conversion outcomes that are known and accepted. Any outcome not listed here must be 'preserved', 'rejected' or 'n/a'. A listed outcome that stops occurring also fails CI, so a fix upstream is noticed and this file is updated in the same pull request. api_outcomes does the same for API vectors: a vector not listed there must not be a defect. scene_outcomes lists the expected replay-scene result per indexer commit; any other result fails CI.
